title: pid can build the shuffled decoy set and compare it against the reversed one
body:
## What exists today

Before `f12fda4`, pid hid its true targets among shuffled Swissprot windows. Since that commit, `build-set --in pid-toy|pid-real` writes whole TrEMBL sequences reversed into `target.fa`, 100 decoys per true pair, with the unreversed originals in `originals.fa`. No label builds the shuffled set any more.

## The change

`build-set` can build the old shuffled decoy set again, beside the reversed one. pid gets a figure comparing shuffled against reversed decoys. The figure shows that reversed sequences make false positives that carry signal, and shuffled ones do not.
close_reason: Jack dropped it. No shuffled decoy set was built for pid.
